content.text: Generate an animated SVG of an anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles.

content.thinking:
I'm planning out an SVG scene of an anteater riding a unicycle—sketching the canvas layout, ground line, rotating wheel with spokes, and the anteater's body parts like snout, tail, legs, and eye before writing the animation code.

For motion, I'm deciding to keep the unicycle stationary while animating the spokes rotating and the ground ticks scrolling to suggest rolling, plus juggling bottles arcing between the anteater's raised paws using animateMotion paths with staggered begin times.

Now I'm working out precise coordinates for the wheel, seat, frame post, and body ellipse so everything lines up visually.

Still defining anteater shapes...

Still working out the juggling path...

Writing bottle motion paths...

Now I'm adding the ground dashes animated with a shifting dash-offset to simulate movement, plus rotating spokes on the wheel timed to match the ground speed so the rolling motion looks physically consistent.

Deciding to skip the crank detail and simplify to a pedal group with rectangles, static hind legs connecting hips to a foot position, and juggling arms with paw-like hands holding crossed bottles. Now I'm adding a bobbing animation transform to the body group for a subtle rhythmic motion.

Writing SVG code...

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="800" height="500">
  <title>Anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#cfe8ff"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="80" r="110" fill="#fff3c4" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="450" width="800" height="50" fill="#9bcf7a"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="450" x2="800" y2="450" stroke="#6aa84f" stroke-width="4"/>
  <!-- Scrolling road markings (suggest forward motion) -->
  <line x1="-40" y1="475" x2="840" y2="475" stroke="#7fb861" stroke-width="6"
        stroke-dasharray="40 40">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="-80" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>

  <!-- Unicycle (wheel + frame) -->
  <g id="unicycle">
    <!-- Frame post and seat -->
    <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="396" y2="268" stroke="#555" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="368" y="258" width="44" height="12" rx="6" fill="#333"/>

    <!-- Wheel -->
    <circle cx="400" cy="380" r="70" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="8"/>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 400 380" to="360 400 380"
                        dur="5.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g stroke="#777" stroke-width="3">
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="400" y2="310"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="450" y2="330"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="470" y2="380"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="450" y2="430"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="400" y2="450"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="350" y2="430"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="330" y2="380"/>
        <line x1="400" y1="380" x2="350" y2="330"/>
      </g>
      <!-- Pedal crank -->
      <line x1="400" y1="370" x2="400" y2="390" stroke="#444" stroke-width="5"/>
      <rect x="385" y="368" width="30" height="5" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
      <rect x="385" y="387" width="30" height="5" rx="2" fill="#444"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="400" cy="380" r="9" fill="#444"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Rider (bobs gently) -->
  <g id="rider">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -3; 0 0"
                      dur="0.55s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M325,215 Q275,245 240,205 Q228,182 255,172" fill="none" stroke="#8c6a40"
          stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Hind legs -->
    <path d="M375,240 Q360,300 392,322" fill="none" stroke="#8c6a40" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M405,240 Q410,300 420,330" fill="none" stroke="#8c6a40" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="398" cy="330" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#5e4528"/>
    <ellipse cx="428" cy="338" rx="14" ry="8" fill="#5e4528"/>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="390" cy="215" rx="70" ry="42" fill="#b08a5a"/>
    <!-- Belly -->
    <ellipse cx="385" cy="232" rx="50" ry="18" fill="#d6b68a"/>

    <!-- Head and long snout -->
    <ellipse cx="465" cy="170" rx="40" ry="32" fill="#b08a5a"/>
    <path d="M490,158 Q560,150 615,180 Q565,194 490,190 Z" fill="#a07d4f"/>
    <ellipse cx="612" cy="180" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#333"/>
    <!-- Ear -->
    <path d="M450,142 Q455,118 472,130 Z" fill="#8c6a40"/>
    <!-- Eye -->
    <circle cx="477" cy="160" r="5" fill="#222"/>
    <circle cx="478" cy="158" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>

    <!-- Arms raised for juggling -->
    <path d="M420,205 Q395,165 365,128" fill="none" stroke="#8c6a40" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M445,212 Q440,170 436,128" fill="none" stroke="#8c6a40" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="126" r="8" fill="#5e4528"/>
    <circle cx="436" cy="126" r="8" fill="#5e4528"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Juggled bottles: each follows the same figure-of-two-arcs path, offset in time -->
  <defs>
    <g id="bottle">
      <rect x="-6" y="-18" width="12" height="30" rx="5" fill="#2e8b57"/>
      <rect x="-3" y="-26" width="6" height="9" rx="2" fill="#2e8b57"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="-2" width="12" height="8" fill="#e8f5e9" opacity="0.8"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <use href="#bottle">
    <animateMotion path="M365,126 Q400,-14 436,126 Q400,-14 365,126 Z" dur="1.8s" begin="0s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </use>
  <use href="#bottle" fill="#c0392b">
    <animateMotion path="M365,126 Q400,-14 436,126 Q400,-14 365,126 Z" dur="1.8s" begin="-0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </use>
  <use href="#bottle" fill="#2471a3">
    <animateMotion path="M365,126 Q400,-14 436,126 Q400,-14 365,126 Z" dur="1.8s" begin="-1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </use>
</svg>

content.thinking:
I'm checking the bottle animation path, which forms a lens-shaped loop with its control points peaking above the baseline, creating a juggling-like arc for the bottles drawn along it.

I realize the bottle fill colors are hardcoded on the rects, so applying different fill attributes to the `use` elements won't actually recolor them—they'd all end up green. I'll fix this by switching the bottle body and neck to use `fill="currentColor"` and setting a `color` attribute on each `use` element instead, so each bottle instance can have its own distinct color.

I created the animated SVG at `/Users/andie/Downloads/anteater-gptge-rerun-20261022-214900/runs/claude-haiku-5-5-medium/work/anteater-unicycle.svg`. Open it in a browser to see it run. I haven't rendered it, so I haven't visually checked the anatomy or the juggling arcs.

What's animated:
- **Wheel and pedals** spin clockwise, and the ground stripes scroll left to suggest forward motion.
- **The anteater** bobs slightly, with a long snout, raised arms, and a curled tail.
- **Three bottles** (green, red, blue) follow the same arc path between the paws, offset in time so they look like a juggling cycle.

The animation uses SVG SMIL (`animate`, `animateTransform`, `animateMotion`), so it runs in browsers but not in some image viewers or editors that ignore SMIL.
